l-e-m3-b07-05.title: Kritériu atu distinge "whose" husi "who's"
l-e-m3-b07-05.goal: Atu hatene ida-ne'ebé husi "whose" no "who's" ba fatin mamuk, deside kritériu (informasaun) ne'ebé presiza duni, no esplika tanbasá ita hili nia.
l-e-m3-b07-05.material: Deside uza "whose" ka "who's" iha fatin mamuk. ① I met a student ___ bike is blue. ② I met a student ___ riding a blue bike.
l-e-m3-b07-05.s.s1.prompt: Kritériu saida mak presiza duni atu deside entre "whose" no "who's"?
l-e-m3-b07-05.s.s1.o.a: Karik iha signifikadu bainhira espande fatin mamuk ba "who is"
l-e-m3-b07-05.s.s1.o.b: Karik liafuan iha oin mak ema
l-e-m3-b07-05.s.s1.r.b: Bele uza rua ne'e hafoin ema, nune'e la bele distinge sira.
l-e-m3-b07-05.s.s1.r.c: Númeru liafuan la iha relasaun ho oinsá uza sira.
l-e-m3-b07-05.s.s1.r.d: Kór la hatudu diferensa entre "whose" no "who's".
l-e-m3-b07-05.s.s1.explain: "who's" mak forma badak ba "who is." ② lee nu'udar "who is riding," nune'e nia mak "who's," no ① labele sai "who is bike," nune'e nia mak "whose."
l-e-m3-b07-05.s.s2.model.0: "who's" mak forma badak ba "who is," nune'e se iha signifikadu bainhira hakerek nakloke ba "who is," uza "who's," se lae uza "whose."
l-e-m3-b07-05.s.s2.model.1: Bainhira tau "who is" atu lee, ② naturál no ① la naturál, nune'e kritériu ida-ne'e de'it bele hatudu diferensa entre fraze rua.

l-e-m3-b01-12.material: a closed door, a broken window, a fallen leaf, a frozen lake. Buka regra hosi signifikadu ne'ebé liafuan molok naran (closed, broken, etc.) fó iha espresaun haat ne'e.

l-e-m3-b01-12.s.s1.o.c: Liafuan dahuluk hatete estadu katak "halo ona" ka "sai ona"
l-e-m3-b01-12.s.s1.o.d: Liafuan dahuluk deskreve de'it hosi hafoin naran
l-e-m3-b01-12.s.s1.r.d: Iha espresaun haat hotu, liafuan dahuluk mai molok naran.
l-e-m3-b01-12.s.s1.explain: Past participle molok naran hatete estadu katak buat ida halo ona ka sai ona hanesan ne'e.
l-e-m3-b01-12.s.s2.model.0: Hanesan odamatan taka no janela rahun, sira mak estadu ne'ebé mosu tanba buat ida akontese ona, nune'e partisípiu pasadu hatudu estadu "remata/sai".
l-e-m3-b01-12.s.s2.model.1: Espresaun haat hotu hatudu oinsá buat sira haree nu'udar rezultadu husi buat ne'ebé remata ona, nune'e regra mak estadu "remata/sai".

l-e-m3-b01-13.s.s2.model.1: Adjetivu la haketak husi how no verbu mai depois de sujeitu, nune'e ne'e mak regra.

l-e-m3-b02-11.title: Regra If + past tense, would
l-e-m3-b02-11.goal: Hosi kazu oioin iha fraze if tolu kona-ba imajinasaun, deskobre no hatete regra, no haree regra ne'e ho kazu foun ida.
l-e-m3-b02-11.material: ① If I had a boat, I would sail every day. ② If we lived near the sea, we would swim often. ③ If I were taller, I would play basketball. Deskobre regra iha fraze tolu ne'e.
l-e-m3-b02-11.s.s1.o.a: Kláuzula if uza tempu prezente, no kláuzula prinsipál uza will
l-e-m3-b02-11.s.s1.r.a: Fraze tolu ne'e iha would, la'ós will.
l-e-m3-b02-11.s.s1.o.b: Kláuzula if iha tempu pasadu hamutuk ho would iha kláuzula prinsipál ko'alia kona-ba imajinasaun
l-e-m3-b02-11.s.s1.o.c: Kláuzula if hakerek iha past perfect
l-e-m3-b02-11.s.s1.r.c: Had a boat mak tempu pasadu simples. La'ós past perfect.
l-e-m3-b02-11.s.s1.o.d: Se iha if, kláuzula prinsipál sempre uza tempu prezente
l-e-m3-b02-11.s.s1.r.d: Kláuzula prinsipál iha would, nune'e la'ós tempu prezente.
l-e-m3-b02-11.s.s1.explain: If + past tense, would + base verb ko'alia kona-ba imajinasaun ne'ebé diferente hosi faktu sira agora. Verbu be normalmente uza were.
l-e-m3-b02-11.s.s2.model.0: Iha fraze tolu hotu, kláuzula if uza tempu pasadu no kláuzula prinsipál iha would, nune'e sira ko'alia kona-ba imajinasaun kona-ba situasaun agora.
l-e-m3-b02-11.s.s2.model.1: Verbu iha tempu pasadu no would mosu hamutuk maibé ida ne'e la'ós realidade, nune'e regra mak imajinasaun ho tempu pasadu + would.

l-e-m3-b02-12.goal: Husi kazu oioin kona-ba fraze haat ho partisípiu depois de substantivu, buka no hatete regra, no verifika regra ne'e ho kazu foun ida.
l-e-m3-b02-12.material: the kid sitting near me / the people waiting outside / the window broken by a ball / the cake baked by my uncle. Buka regra kona-ba oinsá uza -ing no -ed iha fraze haat ne'e.
l-e-m3-b02-12.s.s1.o.a: Uza -ing bainhira substantivu mak halo asaun, no uza -ed bainhira asaun halo ba substantivu.
l-e-m3-b02-12.s.s1.o.b: -ing ko'alia kona-ba tempu liubá no -ed kona-ba futuru.
l-e-m3-b02-12.s.s1.r.b: -ing no -ed hatudu ema ne'ebé halo ka simu asaun, la'ós tempu.
l-e-m3-b02-12.s.s1.r.c: Iha fraze haat hotu, -ed mai depois de substantivu.
l-e-m3-b02-12.s.s1.o.d: Labele uza partisípiu depois de substantivu.
l-e-m3-b02-12.s.s1.r.d: Iha fraze haat hotu, partisípiu mai depois de substantivu.
l-e-m3-b02-12.s.s1.explain: Se substantivu mak halo asaun, aumenta -ing depois de nia. Se asaun halo ba nia, aumenta -ed depois de substantivu.
l-e-m3-b02-12.s.s2.model.0: Labarik ne'ebé tuur no ema sira ne'ebé hein mak sira rasik halo asaun, nune'e uza -ing; janela ne'ebé rahun no bolo ne'ebé tein halo asaun ba sira, nune'e uza -ed.
l-e-m3-b02-12.s.s2.model.1: Bola mak rahun janela no bolo mak tein, nune'e regra mak -ed ba asaun ne'ebé halo ba buat ida, no -ing ba asaun ne'ebé buat ida rasik halo.

l-e-m3-b07-02.title: Regra pergunta indireta ne'ebé hahú ho liafuan pergunta + substantivu

l-e-m3-b07-02.material: What color do you like? → Tell me what color you like. / Which road does the bus take? → Do you know which road the bus takes? / Whose bag is this? → I wonder whose bag this is. Buka regra.

l-e-m3-b07-02.s.s1.explain: Liafuan pergunta + substantivu mai uluk nu'udar grupu ida, tuirmai orden sujeitu + verbu. "do/does" lakon.

l-e-m3-b07-02.s.s2.model.1: Iha ezemplu tolu hotu, sujeitu no verbu tuirmai liafuan pergunta + substantivu, no "do/does" lakon, nune'e hili "what size they need."

l-e-m3-b07-04.title: Uza fraze partisipiu ba razaun negativu
l-e-m3-b07-04.goal: Reeskribe "Because we didn't know the way" nu'udar fraze partisipiu iha forma seluk (ekuasuan, tabela, imajen ka liafuan) no esplika tanbasá signifika hanesan.
l-e-m3-b07-04.material: Because we didn't know the way, we asked for help. Muda fraze ida-ne'e ba fraze partisipiu ne'ebé hahú ho -ing atu halo fraze ho signifikadu hanesan.

l-e-m3-b07-04.s.s1.r.c: "not" falta, nune'e nia signifika katak sira hatene dalan.
l-e-m3-b07-04.s.s1.r.d: "known" signifika "ema hatene nia," signifikadu pasivu, nune'e rona estranhu.
l-e-m3-b07-04.s.s1.explain: Fraze partisipiu negativu tau "Not" kedas molok -ing. Sujeitu "we" iha klausa dahuluk hanesan ho segundu, nune'e hasai.
l-e-m3-b07-04.s.s2.model.0: "Because we didn't know" badak ba "Not knowing," nune'e "Not knowing the way, we asked for help" signifika hanesan.
l-e-m3-b07-04.s.s2.model.1: Sujeitu "we" hanesan iha parte rua, nune'e hasai sujeitu klausa dahuluk no tau "Not" molok -ing, ne'ebé halo fraze ida-ne'e signifika hanesan ho orijinál.
